text: S635 tests one remaining concrete representation variable suggested by S634: coordinate-identical CUT POLYLINE→LWPOLYLINE conversion in the existing CLO Standard import path. All source coordinates, units, settings, SEW and mark entities stay fixed. Inspect the imported/native CUT contours before any export; stop on a native miss, regression, identity error, or UI/settings mismatch. No source geometry, tolerance, gate, or hold change. See E-G04-S635-START.
